verdict.rationale: DBOS is an open-source library that keeps all workflow state in your own Postgres database, with no separate orchestration server, and its CLI can list workflows in JSON. That makes data portability and leaving largely inherent, though no dedicated export feature is documented. missing for 10: an explicit documented full-data export/migration feature, export of Conductor-hosted data (metrics, audit logs, settings), and independent hands-on corroboration of a clean exit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave

citations.quote: The open-source DBOS library uses Postgres to orchestrate durable workflows and queues. There's no separate orchestration server and no infrastructure required besides Postgres.
List workflows run by your application in JSON format ordered by recency
DBOS is an open-source Postgres-backed library.
you can self-host Conductor and the DBOS Console on your development machine using Docker Compose.
